name: Brio
description: A bright forms product with a complete field studio, local respondent preview and versioned response review.

notes.layout: Apricot question playground, graphic feature spreads, three-pane field editor, respondent preview and response review
notes.motion: Form-sheet entrance, theme and card hover, and native dialog movement
notes.interaction: Add and edit five field types, reorder and undo, validate required answers, apply templates, review historical responses and export JSON or CSV
notes.provenance: Six original pages with a tested form schema, local responses that preserve question snapshots, original templates and clear browser-only behavior.
